items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: one of the five pianists there was Ram Ramirez, the guy that wrote “Lover Man.” Wonderful piano player. So I became friends with him

ctx.x: She just understood intuitively that she just was that broadminded. And I’m sure a lot of jazz people got in that way. So it was a very lively time I had there, and I became friends with John and I started working gigs around town. My first close friend was, I lived over a little nightclub called the Little Casino and one of the five pianists there was Ram Ramirez, the guy that wrote “Lover Man.” Wonderful piano player. So I became friends with him and then I joined the union and I started playing jobs and…
